message: Last week, we had an unexpected power outage that left us in the dark. I felt a wave of calm wash over me when I remembered I had charged up our power banks and had a few trusty flashlights stashed away. We ended up playing board games by flashlight, enjoying some cozy snacks, and sharing stories. It turned out to be a delightful little adventure! 🌟 What’s your go-to tip for staying comfortable during an outage?
